_comment: The courses this group is actually enrolled in, confirmed by the student.
The scraper shows a class in the main schedule only when its course code and
lecturer both appear here AND the lecturers' timetable lists the group for
that slot. Anything the university publishes for the group that is not on
this list is still scraped, but is set aside under 'not in your course list'
so a genuine late addition is visible rather than silently dropped.
Delete this file to show everything the university publishes.
